operations.description:
Checks the status of a test matrix.

May return any of the following canonical error codes:

- PERMISSION_DENIED - if the user is not authorized to read project
- INVALID_ARGUMENT - if the request is malformed
- NOT_FOUND - if the Test Matrix does not exist
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] testing projects test matrices [PATH] projects test matrices [PARAMS] access alt callback fields id key matrix oauth pretty print project protocol quota test token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] android client cloud detail details device environment execution google history info ios list matrix result results specification step storage test tool

operations.description:
Gets the catalog of supported test environments.

May return any of the following canonical error codes:

- INVALID_ARGUMENT - if the request is malformed
- NOT_FOUND - if the environment type does not exist
- INTERNAL - if an internal error occurred
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] testing test environment catalog [PATH] test environment catalog [PARAMS] access alt callback environment fields id key oauth pretty print project protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] android catalog configuration device environment ios model network provided runtime software test version xcode

operations.description: Gets the details of an Android application APK.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] testing application detail service apk details [PATH] application detail service apk details [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] apk detail details file manifest reference response

operations.description:
Creates and runs a matrix of tests according to the given specifications.
Unsupported environments will be returned in the state UNSUPPORTED.
Matrices are limited to at most 200 supported executions.

May return any of the following canonical error codes:

- PERMISSION_DENIED - if the user is not authorized to write to project
- INVALID_ARGUMENT - if the request is malformed or if the matrix expands
                     to more than 200 supported executions
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] testing projects test matrices create [PATH] projects test matrices [PARAMS] access alt callback fields id key oauth pretty print project protocol quota request token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] android client cloud detail details device environment execution google history info ios list matrix result results specification step storage test tool

operations.description:
Cancels unfinished test executions in a test matrix.
This call returns immediately and cancellation proceeds asychronously.
If the matrix is already final, this operation will have no effect.

May return any of the following canonical error codes:

- PERMISSION_DENIED - if the user is not authorized to read project
- INVALID_ARGUMENT - if the request is malformed
- NOT_FOUND - if the Test Matrix does not exist
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] testing projects test matrices cancel [PATH] projects test matrices test matrix id cancel [PARAMS] access alt callback fields id key matrix oauth pretty print project protocol quota test token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] cancel matrix response test
